Router.title: AI Proxy Router
Router.description: Centralized, zero-latency API routing for your local AI coding assistants (Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Claude Code). Route all LLM traffic through your preferred provider with automatic model remapping.
Router.keySecurityNote: Keys are stored safely in local server configuration and never transmitted to third-party tracking.
Router.ollamaNote: Make sure Ollama is running (`ollama serve`). No API key needed.
Router.modelOverrideNote: If set, any incoming model request (e.g. gpt-4o from Cursor) will be mapped to this target model.
Router.step1: 1. Select your preferred provider on the left and click Save.
Router.step2: 2. In your editor (Cursor, Roo Code, Cline), set the OpenAI Base URL to:
Router.proTipDesc: You can leave the API Key field in Cursor/Cline blank or enter any dummy string. The router will automatically inject your real configured provider key and headers!
Router.deepseekDesc: DeepSeek-V3 & DeepSeek-R1 models with fast reasoning and very low cost.
Router.openrouterDesc: Access Claude 3.7, GPT-4o, Llama 3.3, and 200+ models via unified API.
Router.geminiDesc: Gemini 2.0 Flash & Pro with high rate limits and fast latency.
Router.groqDesc: Ultra-high tokens/sec inference for Llama 3.3 and DeepSeek R1 distilled.
Router.openaiDesc: Direct API route to GPT-4o, o1, and o3-mini models.
Router.ollamaDesc: Run local models (Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek R1 8B) completely private on your PC.
